description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home!* Approx. 120 ft. to Private Beach Access* Newly Remodeled with Beautiful Updates!* Coffee Bar Provided!* Private Covered Patio Seating* Waterfront Community Pool (Seasonally Heated November - March)* Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* Professionally Managed, 24/7 serviceWelcome to Pelican Watch, your dream coastal retreat tucked inside the exclusive gated community of Sunset Beach—perfectly located between the iconic Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. This beautifully designed 3-bedroom, 4-bath home comfortably sleeps up to 10 guests and offers a seamless blend of luxury, space, and relaxed beach living. Enjoy five private balconies, ideal for sipping your morning coffee at sunrise or unwinding with sunset cocktails in the evening breeze. Inside, the open-concept main living area is perfect for gathering, featuring a spacious living room with a queen sleeper sofa and a full bathroom for added convenience. The chef’s kitchen is a standout, complete with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, a wine fridge, a bar sink, and a large island—perfect for preparing meals or hosting casual gatherings.The home’s thoughtfully designed layout provides comfort and privacy for all guests. The first-floor king suite offers a private bath and easy access for early risers. On the third floor, the master king suite features a private ensuite, a workspace, and two private balconies for a peaceful retreat. The bunk room includes a queen-over-queen bunk, a private bathroom, and a convenient laundry area. Additional features like a tankless water heater ensure endless hot showers after long beach days. With spacious interiors, multiple outdoor living spaces, and an unbeatable location, Pelican Watch is the perfect place to relax, entertain, and create unforgettable coastal memories.**The first-floor patio has been converted into a dedicated beach closet to allow for maximum space in the garage. It’s stocked with items the owner has shared for guest use, including beach chairs, boogie boards, sand toys, and beach towels. Please remember to wash, dry, and fold beach towels before checkout so they're ready for the next guests. Not Guaranteed** The Villas at Sunset Beach is an intimate, gated gulf-front community situated between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, just across the street from the famous, oversized Seacrest Beach chair. The Villas at Sunset Beach sit directly on top of the beach dunes, overlooking the beautiful Gulf of Mexico. While the units at Sunset Beach offer privacy and exclusivity, the location offers all of the shopping and dining options you desire! The community is complete with a waterfront resort pool and private beach access to the white sands of the Emerald Coast!The Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom: King Bed w/En-suite 2nd Floor:Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed w/En-suiteGuest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk BedArea Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole.This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
